## Motivation

A malformed field in a native `/generate` request can pass request construction and reach the scheduler or detokenizer, where a type error terminates the server. For example, a list-valued `regex` becomes an unhashable grammar-cache key, and an oversized `top_k` overflows the scheduler's int32 tensor.

Fixes #41466. All ten fields listed in the report are covered: `positional_embed_overrides`, `lora_id`, `max_new_tokens`, `beam_width`, `regex`, `json_schema`, `ebnf`, `structural_tag`, `skip_special_tokens`, and `top_k`.

## Modifications

- Add shared, non-mutating request preflight before HTTP streaming starts and before request normalization/fan-out. Malformed reported inputs return JSON HTTP 400 for both streaming and non-streaming `/generate`; Python callers receive `ValueError` before scheduler dispatch.
- Validate sampling scalar/grammar types and int32-safe `top_k`, preserve null defaults and disable sentinels, and reject caller-supplied transport normalization state. Model-processor extras such as Whisper's fields remain available.
- Validate session fields, positional-embedding objects/shapes/dimensions, and single/batched LoRA metadata. Normalize valid LoRA path lists and preserve per-request metadata during parallel-sampling expansion.
- Add CPU regressions through the production ASGI routes and tokenizer-manager admission path, plus component, batch, compatibility, and MessagePack tests.

## Prior work and attribution

This consolidates the reported failure cases into one request-boundary fix, with adapted work from:

- #37181 by [fortunecookiee](https://github.com/fortunecookiee): positional-embedding type/rank/dimension validation, adapted from `fe26b926a7ca3d68d6688dd803916054b23b00bb`.
- #34885 by [taking-lying-flat](https://github.com/taking-lying-flat): `normalize_lora_paths` and shared request-boundary integration, from `ff097dc88a5f83bc0c38dcfb19246a3ecac3db9c`.
- #41535 by [sunshinejiali](https://github.com/sunshinejiali): session-field validation policy, implemented here with `ValueError` at the shared boundary.

Related resource-limit work in #36856/#28794, per-prompt session-list support in #28796, schema-complexity limits in #40373, and stop-regex syntax handling in #40985 remain separately scoped. This PR does not add a parallel-sample resource cap or claim to validate every possible native request field.

## Validation

Base: `c02eaadeb28c1e0b41e9730d18fb78dbcd4d7f01`.

- **512 tests passed, 495 subtests passed, 4 CUDA-only tests skipped** across 13 focused and adjacent CPU suites: sampling, request normalization, positional embeddings, field validators, MessagePack IPC, tokenizer request cleanup, OpenAI protocol/chat/completions, Whisper, and native HTTP admission.
- **72 HTTP regression subcases fail on the unchanged base**: they returned HTTP 200 after reaching the mocked scheduler-dispatch boundary. On this patch they return JSON HTTP 400 before any dispatch, and a subsequent valid request succeeds. Coverage includes POST/PUT, streaming/non-streaming, and all ten reported fields.
- **97% changed executable-line coverage (174/179)**; repository threshold is 60%.
- All applicable pre-commit hooks, registered-test validation, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent code review found no actionable issues; separate runs passed the request/sampling and HTTP suites.

The HTTP tests use the real FastAPI app, request classes, tokenizer-manager admission, and dispatch methods. They replace tokenization/model configuration, scheduler transport/results, and process startup. No real-model inference, CUDA server, or GPU-process-survival run is claimed.

Local platform: macOS arm64, Python 3.12.9, PyTorch 2.13.0, msgspec 0.21.1, FastAPI 0.141.1. Local HTTP collection used import-time CPU platform selection to avoid an unrelated optional MLX import; production platform behavior is unchanged. Four accelerator-dependent skips are not counted as GPU validation.

Focused regression commands in the repository's CPU test environment:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/sampling/test_sampling_params.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_request_input_validation.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_embed_overrides.py \
  test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_native_generate_validation.py
```

## Accuracy and performance

This changes request admission and metadata validation, with no kernel or model-forward changes. Valid-request compatibility is covered by the adjacent CPU suites. No inference-speed claim or GPU benchmark is made.

## Checklist

- [x] Format changed files with applicable pre-commit hooks.
- [x] Add registered CPU regression tests and preserve existing valid-input tests.
- [x] Document validation ownership and compatibility behavior in code/test descriptions.
- [x] Record CPU results and accelerator-validation limits explicitly.
- [x] Credit incorporated work and identify overlapping PRs.

## Review and merge

Ready for review of the consolidated scope and implementation. Upstream CI and maintainer approvals remain pending.
